column2: Wrong values, branches, and boundaries; off-by-one and edge conditions; unhandled cases; missing or wrong input validation.
Authn/authz gaps, injection, secrets/PII exposure, unsafe input handling, and misplaced trust in caller-supplied data.
Races, resource leaks, cancellation, swallowed errors, fail-open fallthrough, and partial-failure states.
Weakened expectations, tests that assert constants or their own literals, untested new code, and stale tests.
Casts where guards belong, optional/required drift, invalid-state shapes, and contract breaks between layers.
Copied logic, duplicate types/constants, ignored existing helpers, and cross-file value drift.
Unused, superseded, or unreachable code; debug leftovers; unrelated bundling; files that should not be in the diff.
Lying names, convoluted logic, speculative abstraction, and surprising side effects.
Stale or wrong comments, missing invariant documentation on complex logic, and narration noise.
Chatty or sequential access, overfetch, hot-path waste, and algorithmic complexity regressions.
Logic far from its data, wrong-layer placement, dependency direction, and leaked internals.
Build/CI/config completeness, env handling, packaging, and features wired but not registered (or vice versa).
